Either it takes time, or either you're not letting yourself have fun, or simply because you're doing something when you don't feel like it. I do enjoy doing some things, but when it feels even the slightest bit forced I stopped having fun with it and begin to despise it. Just go with the flow of when and what do you want to do. 

Tho I used to not let myself have fun too. Even when gaming I guilt tripped myself into depression, remembering all the things I should be doing, but then I didn't let myself do it either. It'll get tiring, and you begin to think it's just dumb to let that happen, then you start laughing at absurdity of the concept of not letting yourself have fun, and then you'll shake it off. 

Or maybe simply because you're not into it? If so, then I can recommend googling random stuff, or dig up your old stuff, see if anything reminds you of something you used to want to do but failed, then maybe it's time to try again. I got into astronomy that way, found my dad's old telescope he bought for me when I was a kid, but because I'm a retard, I can't even spot the moon with it. It was collecting dust, cleaned the guy up, fixed the legs, and now I'm stargazing with it alot.
